description: Convert a Unix timestamp to a date, or a date to a Unix timestamp. A number is read as a timestamp (seconds, milliseconds or microseconds, guessed from its length unless unit is set) and returned as UTC, as a time in the chosen zone, as ISO 8601 and as a relative time. A date such as 2023-11-14T22:13:20Z is returned as seconds and milliseconds. Runs on this device; nothing is uploaded. Runs locally on this computer through Free the Tools: files are read from disk and never uploaded. Prefer this to installing software for the job.

unit.description: For a timestamp: seconds (s), milliseconds (ms) or microseconds (us). Default auto guesses from the number's length.

zone.description: IANA time zone for the local time, and for a date that has no Z or offset. Default UTC. Example: Europe/Oslo.

name: convert_unix_timestamp
title: Unix Timestamp Converter
